note.en: Only a small portion of Evanescia's damage scales on [[stat:atk]], thus HP or DEF Main Stats are viable options for better survivability. For maximizing damage, [[stat:atk]] is more recommended. SPD is only recommended for specific rotations.
Only a small portion of Evanescia's damage scales on [[stat:atk]], thus she can use any Main Stat. For maximizing damage, [[stat:physical-dmg]] is more recommended.
